title: Apply for a development application
summary: Learn how to apply for a development application (DA) for a proposed development by applying online.
intro:
When you need a development application (DA) for a proposed development you must apply online.

Before you start your application discuss the local planning and development requirements with your local council.
what_you_need: A MyServiceNSW Account or NSW Planning Portal login details
Copies of documents for uploading, such as payment for NSW Planning Portal service fees

how_to_steps.text: Select ‘Log in with a Service NSW account’ or enter your NSW Planning Portal login details.
Follow the prompts to complete your application.

contact: For more information about the NSW Planning Portal and development applications, contact the Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure.

faqs.q: Where can I find local planning and development requirements?
faqs.a: Before starting your application, discuss local planning and development requirements with your local council.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a development application online?
faqs.a: Select the 'Apply online' button, log in with a Service NSW account or NSW Planning Portal details, and follow the prompts to complete your application.

faqs.q: Who can I contact for more information about development applications?
faqs.a: For more information about the NSW Planning Portal and development applications, contact the Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure.
